b: As many of you know I'm a freak for yellow and black tools but Skil has always had a place in my bag. Mostly because they make unique 12v tools like an auto hammer and right angle impact driver, and now this little guy.

I've been wanting a smol impact like the Makita pen driver forever but $275 for the kit is ridiculous. This little guy has almost the same torque (200in/lb vs 220) but is on sale right now for $40 bucks. It doesn't have a removable battery like the Makita but for the cost difference I don't mind. It's great to have a little driver like this that won't cam out cheap screws.
The Pwrcore Go lineup includes a cool double headed ratchet, this awesome little powered folding Allen wrench, and a couple other things. I believe the ratchet is on sale now as well for 39.99.
